notes:
{告発|こくはつ} refers to publicly accusing or exposing wrongdoing, often used for whistleblowing or reporting crimes.

WRITING:
- {告|こく} (announce, tell, report)
- ⟦{発|はつ}→〜発：04026_hatsu⟧ (emit, dispatch, reveal)

USAGE:
- {告発|こくはつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to accuse, to expose - suru verb)
- {告発|こくはつ}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (accuser, whistleblower)
- ⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧{告発|こくはつ} (internal whistleblowing)

LEGAL CONTEXT:
- Can refer to formal accusations to prosecutors
- Different from ⟦{告訴|こくそ}→告訴：08010_kokuso⟧ which is filing charges by the victim
- {告発|こくはつ} can be made by any third party

MODERN USAGE:
- Commonly used for corporate whistleblowing
- Associated with exposing corruption, fraud, and misconduct
- ⟦{公益|こうえき}→公益：16061_koueki⟧{通報者|つうほうしゃ}{保護法|ほごほう} (Whistleblower Protection Act)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{告訴|こくそ}→告訴：08010_kokuso⟧: criminal complaint filed by the victim
- {告発|こくはつ}: accusation/disclosure by any party

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{告訴|こくそ}→告訴：08010_kokuso⟧ (accusation, pressing charges)
- ⟦{内部|ないぶ}→内部：05583_naibu⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧ (internal reporting)
- ⟦{暴露|ばくろ}→暴露：07630_bakuro⟧ (exposure, revelation)
- ⟦{摘発|てきはつ}→摘発：12935_tekihatsu⟧ (exposure, disclosure)
